text: This document covers higher scale shipping management with pick location restocking, picklist management, and streamlined packing in the *Shipping* section of the app. For lower volume operations or situations where special handling is needed that is not supported in the *Pack Shipment* screen in the Shipping section of the app use the *Shipment Detail* screen described in the [Ship Sales Order](https://moqui.org/docs/apps/Marble+ERP+User+Guide/Order+to+Cash/Ship+Sales+Order) document.
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
